productionAssetPathTrace.build: Vite runtimePublicAssetsPlugin in shinobij.client/vite.config.ts performs the filtered public-to-dist copy. It applies compactGlbDelivery to every .glb under public/pet-models and copies other runtime files verbatim; copyPublicDir is disabled.
productionAssetPathTrace.container: Dockerfile runs npm run build, partitions the resulting shinobij.client/dist/pet-models tree into an image layer, and restores the same tree in the final image.
productionAssetPathTrace.serving: Express serves staticDir (default shinobij.client/dist) through express.static; no request-time model mutation was found.
productionAssetPathTrace.transformDefinition: shinobij.client/scripts/compact-glb-delivery.mjs removes unreachable accessor and bufferView records, copies retained binary payload verbatim, and skips unsupported extensions.
productionAssetPathTrace.finding: The 14 raw-vs-live hash differences were independently regenerated from GitHub main bytes through the exact compactor; every compacted SHA-256 equals the recorded live SHA-256. They are intentional deterministic build output, not stale or unexpected assets.

recommendedCorrection: No production correction is indicated.
